title: SAML attributes
subtitle: Choose which profile fields each SAML application receives.
disabled: SAML identity provider is disabled. Enable it through deployment configuration to manage attributes.
noPartners: No SAML applications are configured. Add a trusted partner through deployment configuration first.
fixedHelp: Persistent NameID and the subject attribute identify the same local account. They cannot be changed here.
loadFailed: Could not load the saved selection.
noAttributes: No additional attributes. This application receives only the fixed subject.
nameHelp: Names start with an ASCII letter; use ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon or hyphen (up to 128 characters). Names must be unique ignoring case; identity and security names are reserved.
previewHelp: Uses the saved selection and current profile values; does not sign in the account or verify login eligibility or MFA.
previewDenied: Preview and account search require the claims preview permission.
dirtyPreview: Save or discard changes before previewing.
missing: {name}: no stored value in {source}; omitted from release.

errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_request: Check the selected application and account.
errors.unknown_partner: This application is no longer configured. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_policy: The selection is invalid. Check the fields and names.
errors.invalid_name: An outgoing name is invalid or reserved.
errors.duplicate_name: Outgoing names must be unique (ignoring case).
